savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: is revoked; except that, to the extent consistent with this order, all determinations, authorizations, regulations, rulings, certificates, orders, directives, contracts, agreements, and other actions made, issued, taken, or entered into under the provisions of Executive Order 11958, as amended, and not revoked, superseded, or otherwise made inapplicable, shall continue in full force and effect until amended, modified, or terminated by appropriate authority.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Keeps in force, to the extent consistent with EO 13637 and not otherwise ended, determinations, authorizations, regulations, rulings, certificates, orders, directives, contracts, agreements and other actions made, issued, taken or entered into under EO 11958, as amended. It saves the products of the order, not any section of the order itself, and does not list delegations.

transfer_provisions.quote: Section 1. Delegation of Functions. The following functions conferred upon the President by the Act, and related laws, are delegated as follows:
transfer_provisions.note: Re-delegates the Arms Export Control Act functions that EO 11958 sec. 1 delegated (to the Secretaries of State and Defense, the Attorney General and the Department of State) and sec. 3 allocates the funds to the Secretary of Defense: the functions and funds are carried forward.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 4 has no effective-date wording and the order has no general effective-date clause; the revocation took effect on signing, 2013-03-08 (printed 78 FR 16131, March 13, 2013).

targets_in_batch_08.EO:11958: sec. 4 ('Executive Order 11958 of January 18, 1977, as amended, is revoked; except that ...'): the whole order, with a proviso that saves actions taken under it and no section of the order itself.

conclusion: EO 13637 (signed 2013-03-08, 78 FR 16129-16132, read once in full) re-delegates the Arms Export Control Act functions (sec. 1), sets coordination (sec. 2), allocates funds to the Secretary of Defense (sec. 3), revokes EO 11958, as amended, with a proviso that actions taken under it continue to the extent consistent with EO 13637 (sec. 4), amends EO 13222 (sec. 5) and has general provisions (sec. 6). The machine scope 'partial' on the ACT record comes from the proviso, which keeps the order's products and not its text; the whole order text is revoked on signing.
